name: Peullethai
overview: Peullethai is a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified as the eighth-born son of Obed-edom. His mention in Scripture is concise, focusing on his lineage within a Levitical family. There are no additional notes or details about his personal life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Peullethai means "worker, wage earner," reflecting a possible characteristic or role associated with him. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it carries a meaningful Hebrew significance that may relate to his duties or identity.
familyAndRelationships: Peullethai is explicitly recorded as the son of Obed-edom, placing him within a notable Levitical household. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Peullethai's significance lies primarily in his identification as a descendant of Obed-edom, a figure associated with the Levitical service. His mention underscores the detailed genealogical records maintained for the tribe of Levi, which were important for the organization and function of temple duties. Though brief, his inclusion highlights the faithfulness in preserving the lineage of those involved in God's service.
